subject: af-dy
title: AF.DY.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 390 (R(AS)CM(II)-34). AF-DY (affinity dynamics) is the subject; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism), RT-DY (reality dynamics) and EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From DYM-SPT: DEC (decentralization). From RT-DY: INFO-DY (information dynamics). From EXT-FT: SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics). From DEC: EXPM (expansionism). From INFO-DY: CULT-SOLD (culture solidification).
